question: Should OpenClaw reject every stable custom Codex app-server newer than 0.144.5 until its generated protocol schema is revalidated, even when the managed bundled binary remains at 0.144.5?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility and operator-policy choice, not a mechanical correctness question: it determines whether existing custom app-server configurations fail at startup after upgrading Codex.

options.title: Accept the validated ceiling
options.body: Keep the 0.143.0–0.144.5 allowlist and require schema regeneration plus explicit review before admitting a newer Codex release.

options.title: Preserve newer custom binaries
options.body: Retain the existing minimum-only policy and limit the bounded-resume path to capabilities that can be safely detected or version-gated.

options.title: Pause for a compatibility policy
options.body: Hold this PR until Codex plugin owners define the supported upgrade contract for custom app-server commands.

recommendation.title: Accept the validated ceiling
recommendation.body: Keep the 0.143.0–0.144.5 allowlist and require schema regeneration plus explicit review before admitting a newer Codex release.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current Codex app-server policy change and is the clearest available technical routing candidate.
